references.text: Joshua carries out what Moses commanded at Mounts Gerizim and Ebal, where the tribes stood to bless and curse, just as described in Deuteronomy.
Moses gives the first instruction that the blessing is to be pronounced on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal.
The immediately following verse mentions the six tribes who were to stand on Mount Ebal for the curse, in contrast to the six tribes on Mount Gerizim.
The list of Jacob's twelve sons, who are the tribes mentioned in Deuteronomy 27:12-13, including Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
Jacob's blessing over his twelve sons, which includes the six tribes mentioned on Mount Gerizim for the blessing.
